changelog: Subtitle burn-in follows at most three validated redirects and never forwards Cookie, Authorization, or Proxy-Authorization credentials to another origin
Subtitle burn-in rejects non-HTTP(S) URLs, user-info URLs, HTML and other unsupported response types, compressed input, and subtitle responses over 2 MiB
Subtitle burn-in rejects connection-managed, malformed, or oversized request headers before subtitle fetching or Media3 setup
message: CS3M v663 — hardened subtitle burn-in transport boundaries
